article.linkText: Coburn leads Hofstra over Fairleigh Dickinson 73-58
article.story: HEMPSTEAD, N.Y. -- — Tareq Coburn had 21 points as Hofstra topped Fairleigh Dickinson 73-58 on Monday night. Isaac Kante had 16 points and nine rebounds for Hofstra (1-1). Kvonn Cramer added 12 points and 10 rebounds and Omar Silverio had 10 points. Jalen Ray, who scored 22 in the opener, had six points on 3-of-12 shooting. Jahlil Jenkins had 17 points for the Knights (0-3). Brandon Rush added 16 points and Joe Munden Jr. had six rebounds. ------ For more AP college basketball coverage: https://apnews.com/Collegebasketball and http://twitter.com/AP--Top25 ------ This was generated by Automated Insights, http://www.automatedinsights.com/ap, using data from STATS LLC, https://www.stats.com
